_comment: skeuo wild_sculpt STAGE 1 — gpt-image-2 designs a flat dark-gray silhouette on white. Verbatim SIL_PROMPT from wild_sculpt.py. quality=low to keep the auth/credit probe cheap; bump to medium/high for real bodies. 1024x1536 = the pipeline's W,H.

inputs.prompt: A single flat solid DARK-GRAY SILHOUETTE shape on a pure white background: the outline of a Fallout PIP-BOY rugged handheld device with a stubby antenna nub. Completely flat fill, no interior detail, no shading, no outline strokes — just the filled silhouette, centered, filling most of the canvas. The PROPORTION and posture must follow the brief — it may be tall and narrow, squat and wide, asymmetric, leaning, angular/geometric or organic; do NOT default to a generic centered rounded blob, make the OVERALL shape distinctive. COMPOSITION RULE (for fit only): somewhere in the shape there is ONE large CONTIGUOUS mass — at least half the area, tall enough and wide enough to seat stacked screens — and the wild parts (horns, fins, tendrils, legs, spikes, blades, claws) grow outward from it. Bold, readable, wildly non-rectangular outline.
